metadata.title: Education at a Glance 2025: Italy country note (tertiary education focus)

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note summarizes indicator results drawn from multiple OECD large-scale data sources (e.g., Survey of Adult Skills/PIAAC) and does not provide an analysis-ready student micro-dataset or an explicit complex-survey weighting procedure for the note itself. The figures and tables referenced (e.g., Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables) are produced using the underlying survey methodology for each source, including appropriate sampling design handling and scaling/estimation procedures as documented in the corresponding Education at a Glance 2025 Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes. Because this document is descriptive and does not report a re-analysis with a specified weight variable (e.g., W_FSTUWT) or replicate-weight scheme, the note should be treated as using OECD-published estimates rather than user-reweighted microdata. For any secondary analysis, analysts should consult the linked technical notes for the exact weight variables and replicate design (if applicable) for each contributing dataset and indicator.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a descriptive country note that reports indicator statistics (e.g., attainment shares, unemployment rates, literacy proficiency levels and score differences) rather than fitting an achievement model with plausible values (PVs) at the student level. The note does not specify any PV estimation workflow or missing-data handling strategy because it does not present an original micro-data analysis; instead, it points readers to the corresponding Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables and technical notes where those methodological details are documented. Therefore, PV and missing-data handling are not applicable to the extraction at the level of this note.

data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025 (Italy country note) provides a descriptive overview of educational attainment, labour-market outcomes, adult literacy proficiency, and education system inputs/organisation, with a thematic emphasis on tertiary education. The note reports cross-country comparisons and time trends using OECD-published indicators, including Survey of Adult Skills/PIAAC literacy proficiency levels and score differences across attainment groups, and unemployment rates by educational attainment for ages 25–34. It highlights intergenerational educational inequality in Italy (a large tertiary-attainment gap by parents’ education), persistent unemployment differentials by attainment, and a relatively high share of adults at low literacy proficiency (≤ Level 1). It also summarizes system-level patterns such as education expenditure per student, teacher salary comparisons, and class size/compulsory instruction time. Because this is not an original student-level ML analysis, no model performance metrics, PV estimation details, or missing-data procedures are reported in the note itself; methodological specifics are deferred to the linked OECD technical notes for each indicator.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction corresponds to an OECD descriptive country note rather than an empirical ML paper. As such, there is no student-level predictive modelling, no reported analytic sample size, no ML algorithm evaluation, and no explicit PV or missing-data handling workflow within the note. The document instead references the Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables and the associated Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes where the underlying survey methods and estimation procedures are documented.
